errors.description: The showcased part is out of frame. The render is 880x1152 and the jacket cloth runs to the top edge and the full right edge; the only background visible is upper-left, behind the neck and shirt. There is therefore NO shoulder silhouette in the picture - the outer shoulder end, the shoulder slope from neck point to shoulder end, and the sleevehead crown are all cropped away. What is legible is the notch lapel, the lapel buttonhole and the welted breast pocket. A shoulder-padding option cannot be read from this frame at all.
errors.expected: A wide front view showing the full shoulder line on both sides against empty ground, as the blueprint draws it with the red pad callout over the wearer's left shoulder from neck point out to shoulder end and down into the armhole
errors.actual: An extreme close crop of the wearer's left forepart; jacket cloth fills the entire right half and top-right corner, so no shoulder edge meets background
errors.correction: Frame the jacket from mid-chest up with clear background on both sides of the body, so both shoulder lines are silhouetted end to end: neck point, the straight run of the shoulder, the shoulder end, and the sleevehead seam turning into the sleeve crown all inside the frame with air around them.

errors.description: Label is '+0.5 cm Soft (Both Sides)'. Only one side of the garment is in frame - the wearer's left forepart, identified by the breast pocket and lapel buttonhole both sitting on the same forepart. The bilateral claim is unverifiable and a customer comparing padding options sees nothing of the pair.
errors.expected: Both shoulders present and matching, as the blueprint draws them
errors.actual: One forepart and one partially cropped shoulder region only
errors.correction: Show the wearer square to camera with both shoulders in frame and the same soft gently rounded 5mm pad expression on each, the two shoulder lines mirroring each other about the centre front.

errors.description: The 0.5 cm pad height is NOT measurable in this frame. Pad height is read at the shoulder end, as the vertical build between the natural deltoid line and the top of the shoulder, and that terminus is outside the crop. There is also no in-frame scale reference against which any figure could be stated. Recorded as not measurable rather than inventing a number.
errors.expected: A shoulder end carrying a slight visibly rounded build over the natural deltoid - soft, compressible, not squared - legible against background
errors.actual: Shoulder end absent from frame; padding height unreadable
errors.correction: Render the shoulder end with a low rounded build sitting just proud of the natural deltoid line, the crown easing smoothly into the sleevehead with no square corner and no roped ridge, so the small amount of soft padding is readable against the ground.

errors.description: Breast pocket profile differs from the drawing. The blueprint draws the chest welt as a straight-edged welt slanting slightly up toward the outside; the render gives a curved boat-shaped barchetta welt. Not the showcased feature, but a visible departure.

errors.correction: Draw the breast pocket as a straight welt with parallel top and bottom edges, slanting gently upward toward the armhole.

notes: The render is a well-made photograph of the wrong subject. Measurable: the lapel buttonhole side, the breast pocket side, the pocket profile, and the absence of traced annotation. NOT measurable: shoulder slope, shoulder end position, pad height, sleevehead crown, roping - none are inside the frame, since cloth reaches every edge except upper-left. For a shoulder option that is a fatal framing choice independent of image quality, and 'Both Sides' cannot be checked at all.
